title: In Emacs, Everything Looks Like a Service
summary: An article exploring how Emacs architecture treats various components and functionalities as services, leveraging its built-in RPC mechanisms and extensibility model to create interconnected services within the editor.
problem_solved: Explains how to architect Emacs extensions as loosely coupled services instead of tightly integrated functions.
why_valuable: Demonstrates a powerful architectural pattern for building modular, extensible applications using Emacs as a platform.
